title: docs(skills): objectstack-platform names the arrangements list of the package customizations read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBUGgrNWoBUQKbyS4GaX5vM)_

Fixes #36828

Clause-②: no (published prose only; names a list the read already returns on main)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：AI 助手照平台技能文档回答「我们在已安装的应用包上改了什么」时，现在知道答案里还有一份「整体编排」清单（字段分组、记录页标签页、操作布局），以前文档没提这份清单。
- 为什么做：属于「定制已安装应用包」专题的收尾。产品已经返回这份清单，说明文档也已更新，只有技能文档还停在旧说法。
- 出错会怎样：只改文档文字，不动产品。写错的话助手会漏读或误读这份清单，撤回这次改动即可。为了不让技能文档变长，同一文件里删了四处重复说法。
- 要你做什么：这是受管的技能文件，需要审批人批准后才能合并。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, the sentence that teaches `GET /packages/hotcrm/customizations` (line 129), plus a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/skills`.

Before: "lists its overrides, extensions and switched-off items".

After: "lists its overrides, extensions, switched-off items and `arrangements` (`{ object, key }` per `fieldGroups`, `relatedLists` or `actionLayout` its object extension writes; no content, no diff)".

No paragraph is added. The file had 3 bytes of token headroom and the new words cost 137 bytes, so four restatements in the same file are cut to pay for them (136 bytes). Each fact keeps another home:

| Cut | Bytes | Where the fact still stands |
|:--|--:|:--|
| "— `createHonoApp({ kernel })` reaches better-auth at `/api/v1/auth/*`" (HTTP Layer warning) | 71 | the same sentence: "(`AuthPlugin` default `/api/v1/auth`)" |
| "with `create-objectstack`" in "Bundled with `create-objectstack` — no network fetch" (The Template) | 25 | the line above: "the only template `create-objectstack` offers" |
| ", and it is the default" (The Template) | 23 | the same sentence ("the only template") and `references/bootstrap.md` ("blank is the default, and the only, template") |
| ", after AuthPlugin" on the platform-app plugins row (Runtime Boot Sequence) | 17 | the list is headed "in this order" and the row sits directly under `AuthPlugin` |

The ceiling row in the token ratchet is not moved.

## Why

PR #36818 added the `arrangements` list to this read and corrected the `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx` copy; the skill copy still named three lists. A tab list, field-group or action-layout arrangement made in the paired customization package appears only in `arrangements`, so an agent taught from the skill missed it.

Shape checked against `main` (1af67b26cd), not the card text:

- `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`, `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema.arrangements`: a strict `{ object, key }`, `key` = `z.enum(CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS)`; its describe says the entry "names it and nothing more: its content is the pair's `object_extension` item, and nothing is compared with the base".
- `packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts`: `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS` = `fieldGroups`, `relatedLists`, `actionLayout`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, the customizations read producer: `arrangements.push({ object: name, key })` for each key the pair's extension body writes, sorted by object, then key.
- `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`: "one `{ object, key }` entry per object and key".

## Tests

Prose only: no behaviour a test pins changes, so no ablation. Skills checks run on head `e00556f59b`:

<details><summary>Gate readings</summary>

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` :: exit 0. "skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md is 6148 tokens (ceiling 6149; headroom 1)"; "61 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings".
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-top-level-keys`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes` :: exit 0 each.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs` :: exit 0 ("Skill docs in sync"); `check:skill-refs` :: exit 0 ("10 generated files in sync with packages/spec"), both after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 50 commands for this diff; reconciliation with `--ran`: 48 run with exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`: they need a whole-tree build and read no file of this diff; CI runs them).
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` :: "VERDICT clean exit 0".

</details>

Size readings for `skills/**` (lines / bytes, `wc`; tokens in the ratchet's own convention):

| | Before (1af67b26cd) | After |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` | 422 lines / 24613 bytes / 6149 tokens | 421 lines / 24611 bytes / 6148 tokens |
| All 14 `skills/*/SKILL.md` together | 4961 lines / 261866 bytes | 4960 lines / 261864 bytes |

## Acceptance notes

- The four cuts sit outside the sentence the card names. They are the only way to keep the token ratchet green without moving its ceiling; each is listed above with the place its fact still stands.
- Open PRs #37442, #37422 and #35129 also change `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`. All three text-merge cleanly with this branch, but the file is left with 1 token of headroom, so whichever lands second re-measures against the ratchet.
- The skill sentence does not name `counts.arrangements`; the card asks for the list only.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` line 129: the new clause.
2. The same file, HTTP Layer warning: the cut after "not `prefix`".
3. The same file, The Template and the boot-sequence row: the three small cuts.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints "skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md is 6148 tokens (ceiling 6149; headroom 1)" and exits 0; `git grep -n "arrangements" -- skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` prints one hit on line 129.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
